name: Pip
subtitle: Pip, the money tracker with a coin mascot
description: Add this source to install Pip and get its updates.

apps.name: Pip
apps.subtitle: Track spending with Pip
apps.localizedDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, keep a daily streak, and see where your money goes. Pip cheers you on.
apps.versionDescription: Small extras: make your own categories (Pip picks an icon and colour for you), dark mode that follows your iPhone (or pick Light or Dark in You), a receipt photo on any entry (camera button next to the note), and badges for good habits. Every 3 badges, the sprout on Pip's head grows, all the way to a flower.
